# Independent Noise vector

`xk-cacophony.json` is the exact `Noise_XK_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256` vector selected from [Cacophony vectors/cacophony.txt](https://github.com/centromere/cacophony/blob/8ee9d41e34a1a596cfa3ab12aa4069ff87dc1247/vectors/cacophony.txt). The static and ephemeral private values are published test material, never runtime credentials. Tests check both peers and every published flight rather than generating expectations with BotHarness code.

Upstream dedicates the vector under [the Unlicense](https://github.com/centromere/cacophony/blob/8ee9d41e34a1a596cfa3ab12aa4069ff87dc1247/LICENSE).
